GUADAGNI's closeness is 1/30 ≈ 0.033, using the question's definition (the reciprocal of the sum of shortest-path lengths to all other nodes).

I loaded the adjacency matrix into a graph and summed the shortest-path lengths from GUADAGNI to the other families. The sum is 30, which gives 1/30 = 0.0333.

The PUCCI family has no marriage ties, so it is unreachable. I summed over the 14 reachable families only. A normalized closeness (networkx's default, which scales by the number of reachable nodes) would instead give 0.436, but that isn't the definition stated in the question.

ANSWER: 0.033
